# CANDIDATE: MORNING_GAP_FADE_VOLUME_DRYUP_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An early gap up that fails to extend on drying volume and overbought RSI signals a short‑term fade. The edge exists because initial gap enthusiasm often lacks follow-through buying pressure, especially when momentum oscillators show exhaustion and volume deteriorates, indicating weak conviction in the upward move.

## Mechanism

Entry: If gap up >0.4% at 9:30‑9:45 ET (price > prior close ×1.004) and price does not make a new high in the next 10 bars, volume declines for three consecutive bars (each bar’s volume < prior bar’s volume), and RSI(14) > 65, enter short at the close of the third declining‑volume bar. Exit: Stop at recent swing high (chart‑stop), TP1 at 1R (risk = entry‑stop distance), runner using a premium‑stop of 20% of ATR (trailing stop adjusted by 20% of ATR from highest high since entry). Regime filters: VIX between 12 and 25, time 9:30‑10:30 ET, price within 0.5% of VWAP (avoid strong trends).
